name: onyxias_lair
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 249 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
Raid plan: 40 players, the tank/healer/dps split is a placeholder. dungeon_run has no raid driver yet; the file is data for the raid leader.
Needs: lava traps (GO_LAVATRAP_1-2) and whelp spawners (GO_WHELP_SPAWNER) in phase 2
